channel.title: Breach updates
channel.description: Signed Breach releases for Apple Silicon

item.title: 0.2.1 Build #17
item.description:
Breach 0.2.1

Fixes selective routing failures after extended use. Fake-IP DNS mappings now survive unrelated DNS lookups and engine restarts, so applications can continue using cached addresses.

Breach retains these routing mappings in a private local cache. Redir-host mode and disabled DNS keep their existing behavior.

Settings opens in its own native Mac window with a Liquid Glass sidebar, grouped controls and automatic saving. Command-comma reopens the last pane used in the current session.

Clicking the Breach logo at the top of the sidebar returns to Dashboard's Overview page.

This build uses ad-hoc code signing and is not Apple-notarized. Sparkle verifies the feed and download using Breach's existing Ed25519 signing key.

item.title: 0.2.1 Build #10
item.description:
Breach 0.2.1

Maintenance release of Breach 0.2 Beta.

Releases now use GitHub for signed downloads and the update feed. Build numbers identify each archive, and a beta build can become stable without rebuilding the app.

This build uses ad-hoc code signing and is not Apple-notarized. Sparkle verifies the feed and download using Breach's existing Ed25519 signing key.
